description: Choose covenants, then intercept analytic judgment snapshots with the matching seal.
name: Consequences Boss V2 · Difficulty 2 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Choose MERCY or REBUKE for every witness, then START JUDGMENT. Apply each witness's chosen seal to its judgment rune. White-ring wisps are protected. Before START JUDGMENT, covenant choices may be changed and preparation gestures may be retried. Each successful cast advances one fixed court snapshot; waiting preserves the current snapshot. A missed cast, broken covenant, protected-wisp strike, action-triggered impact, or rejected SUBMIT ends the episode; a later attempt cannot pass. Fine threads show the analytic path. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or other implementation or hidden-state access. Do not switch to any pre-existing, unrelated, blank, settings or non-task tab. A tab opened by a visible task control is allowed only as part of this task, using its visible controls.
